title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E7 — Fuzz Lady
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E13 — The Maltese Cow
The team foils both an international dope deal and extortionists preying on a Chinese restaurateur (Keye Luke).

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E14 — In Plane Sight
The team must flush a major cocaine trafficker out of Colombia to help a young woman clear her uncle of drug-smuggling.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E15 — The Battle of Bel Air
Reporter Tawnia Baker poses as a computer operator to help the team capture terrorists plotting to assassinate a sheik.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E16 — Say It With Bullets
A woman hires the team to investigate the murder of her brother, who was part of a munitions theft operation.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E17 — Pure-Dee Poison
The team helps a Southern minister (John Amos) break a ring selling poisonous moonshine; guests Bo Hopkins, Tracy Reed.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E18 — It's a Desert Out There
The team fights robbers, led by a bandit (Jeannie Wilson), who ambush tour buses leaving a run-down Nevada casino.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E19 — Chopping Spree
The team investigates a used-car dealer (Dennis Franz) marketing stolen auto parts.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E20 — Harder Than It Looks
The team rescues an heiress (Lori Lethin) from terrorists, only to have her insist on returning to save her terrorist lover.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E21 — Deadly Maneuvers
Mercenaries capture B.A., Face and Murdock, and hold them at a dairy farm, leaving Tawnia and Hannibal to devise a rescue.

title: The A-Team
description:
S2 E22 — Semi-Friendly Persuasion
The team abides by a cult's nonviolent philosophy to defeat corrupt townspeople who burned their community building.
